description: Make a marketplace LISTING SET for ONE product in one call (Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, any store page): the MAIN image on pure white (the product alone filling about 85% of the frame, no text, no props, no added logo), then the secondary images a listing carries — a lifestyle shot, a detail close-up with NO infographic, a scale shot that shows its true size, and the product in use — every one rendered from the product's real photo and held to one visual system (the same light, scale and palette). More shots on request: multi_angle, whats_in_box, back_of_pack, or any shot in your own words. The MAIN renders FIRST and every other image is drawn from it (each waits for it in the queue), so the set matches; pass an approved main as mainImage to redo the rest from it. aplus:true adds Amazon's 7 A+ modules (a 21:9 brand hero and brand promise, 3:2 modules 2-6), each also delivered at its Amazon module's exact pixels, with its text fields suggested only from the product's own data. Priced up front: dryRun:true returns the plan and the exact credits; the charge is that number. Each image is its own queued image job (poll with get_job); they land in the Library. For a batch of ADS use make_static_ads; for one product photo in a scene use plan_ad + generate_image.

aplus.description: also Amazon's 7 A+ modules: 1 brand hero and 7 brand promise at 21:9 (Premium full-width 1464x600 + mobile 600x450), 2-6 at 3:2 (key benefits, how to use, materials and details, lifestyle, what you get; Premium image-with-text 800x600, Basic header 970x600). With shots:[] only the A+ modules

aspectRatio.description: the canvas for the whole set; default 1:1 (the marketplaces' square)

brandId.description: a profile id/name from list_brands; omit for the active profile (passing it pins it like use_brand)

brief.description: the seller's direction for the whole set: a mood, a setting, an audience

copy.description: the seller's own words for A+ text fields, by module id then field, e.g. {aplus_hero:{headline:'…'}}; each is clipped to Amazon's limit. Without it the fields are suggested only from the product's own data, never invented

copyIn.description: A+ words: 'fields' (default) = suggested for Amazon's text fields, none painted; 'image' = the words painted on the picture

description.description: what the product is, when it is not in the catalog

dryRun.description: true = plan and quote only, nothing rendered or charged

image.description: the product photo when it is not in the catalog: an https or upload_file URL, a Library id (L0, L1…) or a local path on the CLI

inBox.description: what ships in the box (for a whats_in_box shot); nothing else is ever drawn in it

mainImage.description: an APPROVED main image (URL or Library id) to draw every other image from instead of rendering a new main

mainJob.description: the mainJob id a previous call returned, when rendering its `remaining`: they are drawn from that main

model.description: image model id from hermoso_capabilities; omit for the default

plan.description: the `plan` (or `remaining`) a previous call returned: render exactly those images, no new plan, with the same image

product.description: the product name or id from list_products: its catalog photo and its own facts are used

shots.description: the images, in order: built-in main, lifestyle, detail, scale, in_use, multi_angle, whats_in_box, back_of_pack, or any shot in your own words. Default: main, lifestyle, detail, scale, in_use. main always comes first when asked

title.description: the product name, when it is not in the catalog

name: make_listing_set
title: Make a marketplace listing set
